2317-4247-7084-8345.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

396-728-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
396-728-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2111-4981-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-2719.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-2719.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-2719.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1385-2173-2469-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3835-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

1379-3259-5953-7175.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-5953-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-5953-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

38-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2510-4484-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2510-4484-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2510-4484-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2921-4775-6553.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2921-4775-6553.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2178-2292-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-2292-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

856-1808-2511-4231.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

997-2178-2857.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
997-2178-2857.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness. You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
997-2178-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2096-2592-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, God-Pharaoh's Gift triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 4/4 Zombie with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Electropotence triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Electropotence trigger, causing you to pay {2}{R} to have the Tree of Perdition token deal damage equal to its power to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

224-4270-5196.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-4270-5196.description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the basic land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

868-2634-3593.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Desperate Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have another Arcane card in hand, you may either cast that card and splice Desperate Ritual onto it, or splice it onto Desperate Ritual to get infinite copies of the effect(s).

747-974-1379-1651-2003.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G} if you don't control a Smaug token
747-974-1379-1651-2003.notablePrerequisites:
Go-Shintai does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
747-974-1379-1651-2003.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If you do, the Smaug that died triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
If you made Treasures this way, activate nine Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's first chapter ability triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two lore counters on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping four artifacts, untapping Contagion Engine and Go-Shintai.
Resolve the second There and Back Again trigger, causing you to search your library for a Mountain and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the third There and Back Again trigger, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Repeat from step 3.

474-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Specimen Collector.
474-1409-4050.description:
Activate Specimen Collector by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Specimen Collector.
Resolve the Specimen Collector trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
The Squirrel and Crab tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair it and either the Squirrel or Crab token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Crab and Squirrel tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

413-1480-3828-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Squirrel Mob.
You control an extra creature.
413-1480-3828-4772.description:
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing a creature to deal 1 damage to Squirrel Mob.
Create two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2730-3175-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

38-2076-3101-3705.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin and Hazoret's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hazoret's Monument trigger, allowing you to loot.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
